verdict.rationale: The evidence implies many-item operations rather than documenting an explicit bulk feature. Dynamic rules and policies apply provisioning, revocation and security controls across users and devices based on attributes. Agents reportedly handle device ordering and retrieval 'across every warehouse and employee worldwide', and the REST API supports paginated list endpoints for scripted iteration. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-action UI or batch API endpoint, documentation of bulk edits or bulk device commands across selected items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
